name: Dien Bien Phu food guide
summary: The culture desk’s nine start with pa pỉnh tộp, then grilled chicken, upland sticky rice, steamed black chicken, ban flower, bitter bamboo, pork in leaves, bon soup, and hearth-dried meat. Vietnam News adds a kitchen-smoked buffalo and does not say it is the same cut. A price and a stall hour are Check on arrival.
body: Eat the Thái table in the basin, at bản Phiêng Lơi when a house is receiving guests. The fish is 1–1.5 kg on the culture desk and on Vietnam News. Vietnamnet says a bit over 1 kg and names carp, trôi, mè, and trắm. Chẩm chéo sits beside the fish on Vietnam News. The culture desk’s recipe does not use that name. Sơn La is the hearth across Pha Đin. Mộc Châu is the yogurt morning further east.

The rice is steamed twice and coloured red, purple, yellow, and green. No account says five colours, and none names the dye plants. The packet you carry is cóong xôi. The culture desk’s nine do not include cơm lam. Vietnamnet says Mường Thanh tám rice is also used for cơm lam. The packet and that tube stay separate. Black chicken stays in Tủa Chùa. Duck with banana flower is three hours on both Vietnam News and Công Thương, with a half-hour soak on one and a one-hour soak on the other.

Hearth-dried meat is buffalo, pork, and beef, still red and hot. Kitchen-smoked buffalo is the other record: about 15 hours on Vietnam News, or 2–3 hours and a resteam on Vietnamnet. Whether they are one cut is Check on arrival. Bamboo worms, Mông wine, mountain goat, and Đà River fish are names on Vietnam News with no method. Vietnam News also names Hương Linh – Tủa Chùa tea and Mường Ảng coffee as products for visitors. A brew is Check on arrival. No restaurant is named.
specialtiesLead: The culture desk’s nine come first. Vietnam News, Vietnamnet, and Công Thương add the rest, including four names that have no method.

sections.heading: City specialties
paragraphs: Twenty-three plates and drinks. The nine are the culture desk’s list of 23 Mar 2020. The buffalo, the duck, the oleaster, and chẩm chéo are described later. Sâu chít, gạo tám, bánh dày, and the three rice cakes are Vietnamnet. Four Vietnam News names have no method, and the price on every one of them is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pa pinh top
spots.address: Bản Phiêng Lơi, at the city entrance
spots.note: Folded grilled fish. The culture desk and Vietnam News use a fish of 1–1.5 kg. Vietnamnet says a bit over 1 kg and names carp, trôi, mè, and trắm. Chẩm chéo is named only by Vietnam News. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cay pinh
spots.address: A Thái hamlet that receives guests
spots.note: Chicken in lemongrass leaves, skin crisp, smelling of mắc khén, with a cup of rice wine. The culture desk does not name the jar or a strength. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Upland sticky rice
spots.note: Steamed twice in a wooden steamer. Red, purple, yellow, and green from leaves, tubers, and fruit the culture desk does not name. Vietnam News calls it multi-colour. It is not cơm lam. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Steamed black chicken
spots.note: Hmong black chicken from Tủa Chùa. Vietnam News soaks it 20 minutes and steams it half an hour over charcoal. A roast with hạt dổi, a hotpot, and a porridge are named without methods. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ban flower
spots.note: Salad, galangal, stir-fry, and sesame, in March on the culture desk. Vietnam News says March and April. Xôi ban, fried flowers with bamboo, and ban soup are names only. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bitter bamboo
spots.note: Sweet-bitter forest bamboo: stir-fried with fermented rice, boiled, grilled, stewed with bone, or a salad. Vietnamnet dips the boiled shoot in chẩm chéo. A season and a price are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Pork grilled in leaves
spots.note: Minced pork shoulder in many layers of leaf, grilled until the outer leaf is dry and the meat is the yellow the culture desk describes. A dipping sauce is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bon soup
spots.note: Thái soup of buffalo or beef skin. The culture desk says sweet dọc bon and wild eggplant. Vietnam News says water taro and wild tomatoes. Both stay. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hearth-dried meat
spots.note: Buffalo, pork, or beef dried over a wood fire until the strips are still red and hot. The kitchen-smoked buffalo is a separate record. A drying time is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Kitchen-smoked buffalo
spots.note: Vietnam News: two hours in the seasoning, about 15 hours over the fire, brown-red. Vietnamnet: 2–3 hours, a slow charcoal dry, often a 30-minute resteam. Whether this is nhứa giảng is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Duck with banana flower
spots.note: Duck and banana flower in banana leaves for three hours. The soak is half an hour on Vietnam News and one hour on Công Thương, which also uses hạt dổi. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cabbage-wrapped oleaster
spots.note: Young green oleaster in cabbage, dipped in chẩm chéo. Vietnamnet adds ginger, coriander, and garlic leaf, and says there is no meat. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cham cheo
spots.note: Two recipes. Vietnam News: mắc khén, salt, fresh and dried chilli, garlic, and broth mix. Vietnamnet: dry-roasted mắc khén, dried chilli, roasted salt, dried coriander, and lemongrass. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sau chit
spots.note: Split the chít stem. The worm is milk-white, held in weak wine, then steeped as wine or cooked as porridge. Not identified as the bamboo worms on Vietnam News. A strength is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Muong Thanh tam rice
spots.note: Mường Thanh rice, opaque and small. The cooked rice is sticky like sticky rice. Vietnamnet also names cơm lam as a use. That tube is not filed here. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh day
spots.note: Mong Tết cake of upland sticky rice, pounded smooth and wrapped in forest dong leaves. With chả or giò, grilled, or with forest honey. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Khau cam
spots.note: Vietnamnet’s clause: sticky rice with lá cẩm, rich and fragrant, from gạo tám. A second step is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Khau hang
spots.note: Steam the paddy, dry it, mill off the husk, and steam it again until done. Vietnamnet prints nothing further. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Khau papa
spots.note: Vietnamnet compares it to lowland bánh nếp and prints no filling and no leaf. A method is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bamboo worms
spots.note: Named by the culture director in Vietnam News. No Vietnamese name and no method were printed. Not identified as sâu chít. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mong wine
spots.note: Named by the culture director in Vietnam News. A grain, a jar, and a strength are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mountain goat
spots.note: Named by the culture director in Vietnam News. A cut and a method are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Da River fish
spots.note: Named by the culture director in Vietnam News. A species and a method are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: Phố đi bộ Mường Thanh is the river street. It is not the 2012 night market on Nguyễn Chí Thanh. Chợ Trung tâm I is the wholesale hall. Bản Phiêng Lơi is a hamlet table, not a stall row. A bylaw hour for the walking street, and an opening hour for the market, are Check on arrival.

spots.name: Muong Thanh walking street
spots.address: Beside the Nậm Rốm, phường Điện Biên Phủ
spots.note: Báo Điện Biên Phủ on 23 Mar 2026 said most booths were not trading yet, outside Ban flower week, and that a few drink stalls at the head of the street were the stop. One trader’s clock was weekday afternoons and evenings, and the weekend through the day. That is not a bylaw hour. Check on arrival.

spots.name: Central Market I
spots.address: Old phường Tân Thanh, now phường Điện Biên Phủ
spots.note: The 2018 provincial television survey names it as a wholesale market in the city. A later city-paper piece says it opened in 1992 with 150 kiosks. Neither prints an opening hour. What is on the breakfast table is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Nguyen Chi Thanh night market
spots.nameVi: Phố chợ đêm Nguyễn Chí Thanh
spots.address: Nguyễn Chí Thanh, as printed in 2012
spots.note: The national tourism desk’s 15 Mar 2012 note says daily 20:00–23:30, from the Trần Đăng Ninh junction to the provincial youth-house crossing. Whether that market still opens is Check on arrival. It is not the 2026 walking street.

spots.name: Ban Phieng Loi
spots.note: Vietnam News quotes the culture director on the Thái meal at this hamlet. The 2026 flower note names it as a food stop. A weekly hour, and the kilometers, are Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Dien Bien Phu food guide — the Thái table, not Sơn La
seoDescription: Pa pỉnh tộp and the culture desk’s nine, plus smoked buffalo, duck with banana flower, and chẩm chéo. Streets are separate. A price is Check on arrival.
